_: SWDY export revenue share, read from the company's OWN audited consolidated statements. Committed 08-09-2026 because the walk-forward panel captured revenue by PRODUCT SEGMENT and no currency or geographic split, so the dollar-linked proportion of earnings could not be measured from what the run committed. [R-FCAL-01 AMENDED]'s own lesson: what a process commits decides what can ever be asked of it later.
why_it_matters: The reverse read shows the market discounting this company at 12.83% where this lens applies 23.10%, with the gap WIDEST where Egypt's own rates were highest. That is the signature of country risk charged against income that does not suffer it. [R-COC-01] requires the cost of capital to be in the CASH-FLOW CURRENCY and country risk counted EXACTLY ONCE, and this figure is what a currency-matched rate has to be weighted on.
line_read: Export Sales and construction revenues, against Total revenue without inter-segment sales, both from the segment note of the consolidated financial statements
route: text_layer via pdftotext -layout; every figure footed against the printed total on its own page
what_this_is_not: It is an EXPORT share, not a currency share. Export revenue is a lower bound on dollar-linked earnings and not the same quantity: some domestic sales are priced off dollar inputs, and some export sales are invoiced in other currencies. It is committed as the measurable proxy it is, named as such, rather than presented as the currency split it is not.
still_missing: No period carries a currency-of-invoice disclosure, so the share of earnings genuinely denominated in dollars is not measurable from these filings. Stated rather than estimated.
